## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector leadership (Energy, Healthcare, Consumer Staples showing strength) alongside major tech names in CORRECTION, supporting a balanced, non-directional stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +10.24%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples: PM (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +13.13%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +9.72%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +6.26%) CORRECTION. Financials mixed/soft: JPM (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND but V (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +8.21%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +10.08%) CORRECTION. Communication showing weakness: NFLX (1W: -6.99% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND, WBD (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.65%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +13.13%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.94% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: WBD (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -5.29% | 1M: +17.07%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +4.24%) CORRECTION, NFLX (1W: -6.99% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated: Narrow (3/5 Technology/Communication).

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: ABT (1W: +12.66%), PSX (1W: +7.77%), T (1W: +7.51%), PM (1W: +7.42%), XOM (1W: +6.88%). Major divergence flagged: multiple mega-cap techs (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META) show 1W vs 1M conflict → Major Divergence, watch for trend break rather than commit fresh large positions.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, tilted toward CORRECTION across large caps. AAPL (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +9.72%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +6.26%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -7.95% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Technology showing weakness versus the market.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed but not leading; pockets of strength. JPM (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND while V (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +8.21%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +10.08%) CORRECTION—breadth internal rotation with selective strength in banks/payments.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relatively constructive with several leaders. ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND; notable weakness in surgical names: ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare holding up within the market.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and select Healthcare and Consumer Staples names showing ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap techs currently in CORRECTION. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, monitor megacap tech divergence before increasing growth risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through on strength; PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND — momentum in Energy. BEARISH: ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND — downside continuation risk; GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND — watch for further weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (breadth leadership from XOM/PSX/COP) — positive momentum. BEARISH: Technology (large-cap CORRECTIONs) — watch for extension of the tech-led pullback.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XOM (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND — hold recent breakout for continuation. AAPL (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +9.72%) CORRECTION — watch 1M support area for stability. ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND — breach of near-term support would confirm further downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WBD (+85): Paramount EU approval headline; price diverging — WBD (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price falling (distribution). JNJ (+80): surgical robot FDA nod; JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. PSX not in sentiment list but PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND — momentum aligned with sector strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (-65): Senate probe headline; AMZN (1W: -3.97% | 1M: +5.18%) CORRECTION — news confirming near-term pressure. ISRG (-50): fair value cut; ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and downside risk elevated. LLY (-50): legal/competitive headline; LLY (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment is diverging from price, monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: Major Divergence among mega-cap techs in CORRECTION and notable bullish news/price divergence at WBD — watch for confirmation before shifting beta.
